extraction.disclaimer_span: We do not offer every plan available in your area. Currently we represent 26 organizations which offer 3,740 products in your area. Please contact Medicare.gov or 1-800-MEDICARE to get information on all of your options.
extraction.benefits_span: The Aetna plan available in Orange County has a $45 monthly premium, a $65 drug deductible and a $5200 maximum out-of-pocket.
extraction.soa_span: I've sent the Scope of Appointment to your email so we can go over specific plans. Can you sign it while we're on the line?

composition.summary: The agent followed the required steps by delivering the disclaimer before discussing benefits and collecting the Scope of Appointment before scheduling the appointment. However, the agent collected Medicare number and date of birth, which should not be shared.
composition.coaching_note: Dana did a good job delivering the disclaimer and collecting the Scope of Appointment. However, it's important to avoid collecting sensitive information like Medicare numbers and dates of birth during the call. This can be improved by ensuring that all personal information is handled securely and only shared as necessary.
